courses.summary: 約翰卡斯特貝格在巴倫支海採 FPSO 與海底模板架構；本課聚焦高緯度物流與多來源設施連接。本課依序分析高緯度維修等待、低溫熱損失邊界、出貨窗口緩衝、船上模組重量帳、海底與船上量測，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Johan Castberg uses an FPSO and subsea templates in the Barents Sea; this case focuses on high-latitude logistics and multi-source interfaces. The course analyses high-latitude maintenance waiting, cold-environment heat-loss boundary, buffer for export windows, onboard module weight account, subsea-to-onboard measurement, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
